<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent-decl "<!ENTITY internal-ent 'Nested Entity Value'>">
  %ent-decl;
  <!ENTITY ext-ent SYSTEM "external.ent">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY bin-ent SYSTEM "binary.png" NDATA png>
  <!ATTLIST root version CDATA #REQUIRED>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns/root" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/ns/sub" version="1.0">
  <!-- Top-level commentary block covering namespace and processing instructions -->
  <?custom-pi data="process-start"?>
  <sub:child sub:id="c1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing markup-like strings: <child>&internal-ent;</child>
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ext-ent;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE database [
  <!ELEMENT database (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param-macro "<!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA | sub)*>">
  %param-macro;
  <!ELEMENT sub (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY shared-ref "Shared Reference Text">
  <?pi-target param="value"?>
]>
<database xmlns="http://example.org/db" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Database entry containing multiple rare constructs -->
  <record xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.org">
    <sub id="s1">
      <![CDATA[
        Specialized CDATA block with entity references inside: &shared-ref;
      ]]>
    </sub>
  </record>
</database>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY entity-alpha "Alpha Value">
  <!ENTITY entity-beta "&entity-alpha; and Beta">
  <!NOTATION text-format SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY raw-file "file.txt" NDATA text-format>
  <!ENTITY % ext-dtd SYSTEM "ext.dtd">
  %ext-dtd;
]>
<?xml-log level="debug" target="stdout"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://schemas.example.com/catalog" xmlns:m="http://schemas.example.com/catalog/meta">
  <!-- Comment detailing catalog items -->
  <m:header>
    <?m:pi command="initialize"?>
  </m:header>
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      Raw payload data containing entities: &entity-beta;
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section*)>
  <!ELEMENT section (paragraph+)>
  <!ELEMENT paragraph (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base-ent "Base Entity">
  <!ENTITY derived-ent "Derived from &base-ent;">
  <!ENTITY % dtd-snippet "<!ATTLIST paragraph status CDATA 'draft'>">
  %dtd-snippet;
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY doc-file "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
]>
<?xml-resource type="config" src="config.xml"?>
<document xmlns="http://doc.example.net/ns" xmlns:doc="http://doc.example.net/ns/doc" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <!-- Comment section before deep namespace usage -->
  <doc:section id="sec-1">
    <paragraph status="final">
      <![CDATA[
        Complex CDATA block: <paragraph>&derived-ent;</paragraph>
      ]]>
    </paragraph>
  </doc:section>
</document>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (entry*)>
  <!ELEMENT entry (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent-one "Entity One Content">
  <!ENTITY ent-two "Entity Two references &ent-one;">
  <!ENTITY % macro-def "<!ELEMENT entry (#PCDATA | note)*> <!ELEMENT note (#PCDATA)>">
  %macro-def;
  <?xml-meta author="fuzzer" version="2.0"?>
]>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/schema" xmlns:atom="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <!-- Archive description comment block -->
  <atom:entry>
    <dc:title>
      <![CDATA[
        CDATA section with embedded tags and entity: &ent-two;
      ]]>
    </dc:title>
  </atom:entry>
</archive>
